sources.summary: The dated original operator article states that four different enterprise industries currently use the same data hall, identifies it as Austin One Data Hall 3, and describes installed customer environments. This supports current commercial operation of the existing Austin One host. It does not date the historical installations, certify uptime, or establish commissioned capacity.

extraction.date_semantics: The visible publication date is October 2, 2026, consistent with the original WordPress post date. Present-tense current-hosting wording supplies the observation; webpage modification and retrieval dates are excluded.
extraction.physical_scope: One existing Austin One host. Data Hall 3 and its four customer deployments are internal scope, not new sites or separately admitted construction phases. No power, floor area, load or service-level claim is selected.
extraction.successor_review: The operator’s original latest-20 WordPress feed includes November 6, 2026 as its newest article. Its full sizing guide and the current Austin location page were read; no later closure or changed physical status was identified in those originals or bounded targeted searches through November 11. Generic availability and November 6 deployment advice do not replace the October 2 current-workload observation. This is not an exhaustive incident history.

sources.title: Element Critical Austin One: named facility and exact 8025 North Interstate Highway 35 address
sources.summary: The original facility page names Austin One and its exact 8025 North Interstate Highway 35, Austin, Texas 78753 address. The original September 14, 2021 acquisition announcement names the acquired facility Austin One but does not identify the seller. This undated page supplies identity and current operator context, without assigning its CMS modification date to physical status.

extraction.date_scope: The facility page has no dated physical observation; its CMS dateModified is not a status date. The September 14, 2021 acquisition publication is historical identity context.
extraction.scope: One existing host. Internal data halls and past renovations do not create a second physical site. Corporate headquarters at 901 S MoPac Expressway is excluded.
extraction.identity_and_nearby_review: All four baseline identity layers were searched: 1,286 sites, 1,395 projects, 231 identity-mapping records and 231 decisions, and 231 original source records. Element Critical, elementcritical, vXchnge, TX-01 and the exact 8025 address produced no matching host; bare 8025 substrings in unrelated UUIDs/source hashes were reviewed and rejected. The original September 14, 2021 operator announcement names the acquired Austin One facility but does not identify its seller. vXchnge and TX-01 are conservatively searched discovery aliases, not identities established by that announcement. Distances to all 1,286 complete existing site geometries, including polygons, were checked; no host is within 2 km. The nearest is Sabey SDC Austin Round Rock, 16.437 km away.
